summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with LooseVersion but introduces a regex pattern that may not cover all valid version strings according to PEP 440.

issues.description: The regex pattern used to strip non-numeric parts of the version string does not fully comply with PEP 440 and may not handle all valid version strings correctly.
The change lacks additional tests for various valid PEP 440 version strings to ensure the fix is robust.
